name: Bookitbee
shortDescription: A UK event-ticketing and registration platform from LIVE IT Group, with paid and free event registration, donations and mobile check-in.
company: LIVE IT Group Ltd (company number 08432364), trading as Bookitbee
suitableContexts: Churches running free registrations, paid events or conferences
Teams that need online ticketing and on-the-day mobile check-in
Charities wanting to collect optional donations alongside registrations

pricing.summary: Bookitbee publishes no monthly subscription fee and no charge for free events. Its Standard plan is published at 3.5% of ticket price plus payment-processing fees, and Plus at 6.5% plus payment-processing fees. The supplier describes fee caps in GBP and gives organisers choices about passing booking fees to attendees.

tiers.label: Free events
tiers.detail: Supplier states that free-event registrations have no Bookitbee fee.

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.price: 3.5% of ticket price plus payment-processing fees
tiers.detail: Unlimited events, custom data collection, discount codes, donations and mobile ticket scanning.

tiers.label: Plus
tiers.price: 6.5% of ticket price plus payment-processing fees
tiers.detail: Adds allocated seating, box-office point of sale, payment plans, invite-only events and priority email support.

gdprInformation: Bookitbee’s current terms identify LIVE IT Group Ltd as the service provider. The reviewed sources do not establish complete current controller/processor roles, hosting, sub-processors, retention, attendee-data export, deletion or direct-marketing arrangements for a church’s use. Obtain the live privacy, data-processing and payment terms before collecting attendee or donor data.
coreFeatures: Custom ticket and attendee data collection
Stripe, PayPal and LIVE IT Payments options
Daily payouts using an organiser’s Stripe account
Allocated seating and box office on Plus
Attendee data download and Mailchimp sync stated by supplier
integrations: Apple Wallet and Google Wallet ticket branding on Plus
importExport: Supplier describes attendee-data downloads and Mailchimp sync
Confirm the current export format, retention, access permissions and deletion workflow before purchase
support: Supplier advertises 24/7 support on the product page
Confirm incident response and event-day support arrangements for a critical event

uk-operator.value: LIVE IT Group’s terms identify LIVE IT Group Ltd, number 08432364, as trading as Bookitbee and providing the service from London.

product-scope.value: Bookitbee documents event setup, ticket sales, attendee management, custom questions, donation add-ons and mobile check-in.

published-pricing.value: Supplier publishes free-event access and Standard and Plus percentage fees, plus payment-processing fees and GBP fee caps.

data-access.value: Supplier states that organisers can download attendee data and can sync with Mailchimp.

editorial.assessment: Bookitbee is a general UK event-ticketing platform, rather than a church database, Gift Aid system or safeguarding platform. It can be a practical option for church conferences, paid events and free registrations because its documented workflow includes ticketing, custom attendee questions, donations and check-in. A church should separate event administration from any pastoral or safeguarding records and review the data and payment terms before collecting personal information.
bestFor: Church events that need free registration or paid tickets
Teams seeking ticket scanning and registration administration
Organisers that want an optional donation or merchandise step during checkout
strengths: Identified UK operator and public terms
No published fee for free events
Clear percentage pricing for paid tickets
Ticketing, donations, custom questions and mobile check-in are documented
limitations: Transaction and payment-processing fees can materially affect event economics
Do not treat a ticketing checkout as a substitute for consent, safeguarding or pastoral-record processes
Current data-processing, retention, export and deletion terms need written review before collecting attendee data

procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Model the full fee and refund outcome for a real church event, then check attendee-data fields, export, marketing consent, payment responsibilities and event-day support
